basic_details.job_title: NIPER Ahmedabad Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 6 Accountant, System Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Six regular non-faculty posts at Pay Levels 4 to 10 (7th CPC) are open at the National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER) - Ahmedabad, an Institute of National Importance under the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, Government of India. The posts are System Engineer, Public Relation Officer, Accountant (two posts), Junior Hindi Translator and Junior Technical Assistant, with qualifications ranging from Senior Secondary (10+2) with Science to post-graduation. Only Indian nationals may apply. The online application on niperahmnt.samarth.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is not exceeding 40 years for System Engineer, not exceeding 35 years for Public Relation Officer, both Accountant posts and Junior Hindi Translator, and not exceeding 27 years for Junior Technical Assistant. Age is counted as on the last date for online submission of applications. The notice states that no age relaxation will be applicable to SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) posts. | Category Relaxation OBC 3 years against reserved posts only SC/ST 5 years against reserved posts only PwBD (40% minimum disability) 15 years for SC/ST, 13 years for OBC, 10 years for others, against posts identified suitable; maximum age not exceeding 56 years on the last date for receipt of application Ex-Servicemen As per Government of India norms (Annexure IV) Central Govt. / Central Govt. Autonomous organization employees Up to 5 years, for those on sanctioned posts with regular pay scales who have rendered not less than three years of regular and continuous service as on the closing date and are educationally qualified with relevant experience | A person with 40% or more disability is eligible to apply as PwBD. The proof of disability must be enclosed as per Annexure III-I, III-II or III-III (whichever applies); without it the application will be treated as "General (unreserved)". Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

qualification.details: Candidates should have good knowledge of Hindi along with the qualifications. Experience is counted only after the date of possessing the essential educational qualification. Experience gained during full-time education will not be counted as professional experience. "Relevant experience" means experience related to the area of the post advertised. The Screening/Shortlisting Committee will decide the relevance of experience. Experience certificates, especially from a private employer, must mention the designation, nature of work performed, duration of employment, pay particulars and nature of employment (Regular/Contractual/Outsourced etc.). Applicants with experience certificates from PSU/Autonomous Bodies having different pay scales on regular posts must submit an equivalence certificate; otherwise the experience will not be considered. Candidates should not have faced any action by any law enforcement agency and should not have been convicted by any Court of Law, either in India or abroad. Candidates with degrees, diplomas or certificates from any institution declared fake/derecognized by the UGC/AICTE/PCI/AIU are not eligible. Persons dismissed by the Union Government, a State Government, a Local Authority or a Government Corporation owned or controlled by the Central or a State Government are ineligible.

how_to_apply: Applications are made online and the printed copy is then sent by post. The steps given in the notice are:

Fill in the online application on the NIPER Ahmedabad Samarth portal (niperahmnt.samarth.edu.in) between 16 November 2026 (11.00 AM) and 21 December 2026 (11:59:59 PM). Enter your full name as it appears on the Matriculation / Secondary School Certificate.
Pay the non-refundable application fee online. If you apply for more than one post, apply for each post separately and pay the fee separately.
Note the application number generated after successful submission; all correspondence must quote it.
Download and print the application form.
Attach the e-receipt of the fee and self-attested copies of testimonials, degrees and certificates.
Write on the envelope: "Application for the Post of '..........' vide advertisement no. NIPER-A/NF/2026/Estt/001 Dated 16/11/2026".
Send it by Speed Post / Registered Post to: The Registrar, National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER), Ahmedabad, Palaj, Gandhinagar-382355, Gujarat, India.
The hard copy must reach the Institute by 28 December 2026. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

An application cannot be altered after it is submitted. A candidate who wishes to correct it may reapply by paying the fee again. Multiple applications for the same post will lead to cancellation of candidature. For queries, the notice gives the email [email protected] and telephone 079 65181209.
The fee is non-refundable and must be paid only through the online process. The proof of payment (e-receipt) must be attached to the application.

Applicants serving in Government / Semi-Government / Public Sector Undertakings / Autonomous organizations must send their application, in the prescribed format, along with relevant documents "Through Proper Channel".
They may send an advance copy, but their candidature will be considered only if the application is received through the proper channel.

When forwarding the application, the employer must furnish a Vigilance Clearance Certificate stating that the official is clear from a vigilance angle and no disciplinary case is pending or contemplated (Annexure-V).
A No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present organization must be produced at document verification / interview (if called) or at later stages of selection.
Printout of the downloaded online application form
e-receipt of the application fee (where a fee is payable)
Self-attested copies of date of birth proof, degrees, certificates, mark sheets and experience certificates; incomplete hard copies or those without supporting documents will be rejected
Date of birth proof: only Birth Certificate / SSLC / Matriculation / SSC marksheet or certificate issued by the concerned education board
Attested copy of Gazette Notification, if the name was changed after Matriculation / Secondary School
SC/ST certificate in the Annexure-I format, if applicable
OBC certificate with creamy-layer exclusion in the Annexure-II format, not older than one year, if applicable
Disability certificate as per Annexure III-I, III-II or III-III, for PwBD applicants
Equivalence certificate, for experience in PSU/Autonomous Bodies with different pay scales
Employer's Certificate / Vigilance Clearance (Annexure-V) and NOC, for in-service applicants

content_sections.heading: About NIPER Ahmedabad
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education & Research (NIPER) - Ahmedabad is described in the notice as an Institute of National Importance. It was established by an Act of Parliament under the aegis of the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, Government of India. The Institute is located at Palaj, Gandhinagar-382355, Gujarat. This notification covers direct recruitment to non-faculty posts on a regular basis through open competition on an all-India basis. The notice states that the Institute strives to have a workforce that reflects gender balance, and it encourages women candidates to apply.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: NIPER Ahmedabad has advertised 6 posts in total: 4 Unreserved and 2 for Scheduled Castes. The table below shows the posts as printed in the notification. Three of the posts are against lien vacancies. The notice prints these notes: System Engineer: the lien vacancy is likely to be regular by 26-06-2027, if the lien is vacated by the lien holder or terminated by the Institute, whichever is earlier. Accountant: the lien vacancy is likely to be regular by 29.08.2027, on the same condition. Junior Hindi Translator: the lien vacancy is likely to be regular by 04.05.2028, on the same condition. The UR category vacancy is against a post on which an individual holds a lien. If that individual joins back NIPER Ahmedabad, the selected candidate will be reverted to the parent organisation or post previously held, or their services will be terminated with immediate effect, as the case may be. If the regular incumbents do not repatriate to the Institute, candidates selected against lien vacancies shall be considered for permanent absorption at NIPER-Ahmedabad, subject to the defined probation period.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only candidates of Indian nationality can apply. The crucial date for determining the age limit, essential qualification and experience is the last date for online submission of applications (21 December 2026). Each post's requirements are listed below in the notice's order. Essential Qualification: Post-Graduation in Computer engineering or Computer Applications from a recognised University/Institute. Experience: 5 (Five) years of experience in systems administration and networking, with familiarity with different operating systems such as UNIX, SOLARIS, HP-AUX etc. Desirable: Proficiency in higher level languages like FORTRAN, C and UNIX Shell programming and Perl Scripts; experience of managing enterprise networks. Age limit: Not exceeding 40 years. Probation: 02 (Two) years. Educational Qualification: Post Graduate in any discipline from a recognised University/Institute. Experience: At least 5 (five) years of experience in Public Relation / Training and Placement Cell in Central/ State Govt. Organisations or University /Research Institution or Central / State autonomous/ other recognised institute of repute. Desirable: MBA OR Post Graduate Degree/ Diploma in Mass Communication; ability to compose and edit press releases and newsletters. Age limit: Not exceeding 35 years. Probation: 2 (Two) years. The notice gives the same requirements for both Accountant posts. Essential Qualification: B.Com from a recognised University/institute. Essential Experience: 03 (Three) years of experience in any Central / State Govt. or University/ PSU and other Central / State Autonomous or other recognised institute of repute. Desirable Qualification: M.Com / MBA in Finance. Age limit: Not exceeding 35 years. Probation: 02 (Two) years. Essential Qualification (any one of the following): (i) Master's Degree of a recognized university in Hindi or English with English or Hindi as a main subject at the degree level; OR (ii) Master's degree from a recognized University in any subject with Hindi as medium of Examination with English as a compulsory subject at degree level; OR (iii) Bachelor's degree with Hindi and English as main subject, either of the two as medium of Examination and the other as main subject, plus a recognized diploma/Certificate Course in translation from Hindi to English and vice versa, or two years' experience of translation work from Hindi to English and vice versa in a Central Government Office, including a Government of India undertaking. Desirable Qualification: Proficiency in Computer operation. Age limit: Not exceeding 35 years. Probation: 2 (Two) years. Essential Qualification: Senior Secondary (10+2) with Science Subject. Desirable Qualification: Knowledge of computer. Age limit: Not exceeding 27 years. Probation: 02 (Two) years. Candidates should have good knowledge of Hindi along with the qualifications. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: In addition to basic pay, Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance and Transport Allowance are payable as per extant rules. Employees will also be eligible for other benefits such as Medical, LTC and Children's Education Allowance as per the Institute norms. The selection committee reserves the right to give a higher initial pay and position to exceptionally qualified and deserving selected applicants. The notification does not mention the in-hand salary. Appointments under direct recruitment are regular in nature, with a probation period of 2 years for each post; confirmation depends on satisfactory performance. All appointees, including in-service candidates, shall be governed by the New Pension Scheme (NPS). After joining, staff must abide by the Rules, Regulations, Ordinances, Statutes and Act of the Institute, and may be assigned any duty within or outside the Institute depending on the exigency of work. Permission for forwarding applications and issue of a No Objection Certificate (NOC) will not be granted to employees during the probation period. The candidate finally approved must produce a Medical Certificate from an authorized Government Medical Officer at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notification does not fix the selection stages; the Institute reserves the right to decide the mode of screening and testing. Based on the number of applicants, NIPER Ahmedabad may hold a written / skill test / presentation and/or interview for the posts, together or separately, on one or several days. The pattern of examination and syllabus will be published on https://niperahm.ac.in/ . Applications are screened on the basis of the data entered in the online form. Meeting the minimum qualification does not entitle a candidate to a call letter. The Institute may restrict the number of applicants called for any stage based on qualifications and experience higher than the minimum, and may decide the qualifying marks of any stage. Call letters and other correspondence for the interview will be sent only to eligible candidates, by email only. Original testimonials, certificates and degrees must be produced at the test/interview, failing which the candidate will not be allowed to appear. No TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for attending the test/interview. Admission to the test/presentation/interview is strictly provisional.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIPER Ahmedabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 non-faculty posts in total, 4 Unreserved and 2 reserved for SC.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NIPER Ahmedabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 21 December 2026 at 11:59:59 PM. The hard copy must reach the Institute by 28 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NIPER Ahmedabad Accountant post?
faq.answer: The Accountant posts require a B.Com from a recognised University/institute and 3 years of experience in a Central / State Govt., University, PSU, autonomous body or other recognised institute of repute. M.Com / MBA in Finance is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Can a 12th pass candidate apply to NIPER Ahmedabad?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Junior Technical Assistant post, which requires Senior Secondary (10+2) with Science Subject. This post is reserved for SC and has an age limit of not exceeding 27 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NIPER Ahmedabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The limit is not exceeding 40 years for System Engineer, 35 years for Public Relation Officer, Accountant and Junior Hindi Translator, and 27 years for Junior Technical Assistant, counted on the last date for online submission.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 2,000/- for the Pay Level 10 post (System Engineer) and Rs. 1,000/- for all other posts. SC, ST and PwBD applicants are exempted, and the fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. What pay level do the NIPER Ahmedabad posts carry?
faq.answer: The posts carry 7th CPC Pay Level 10 (System Engineer), Level 8 (Public Relation Officer), Level 7 (Accountant), Level 6 (Junior Hindi Translator) and Level 4 (Junior Technical Assistant), plus DA, HRA and Transport Allowance as per rules.

faq.question: Q8. Is a hard copy of the application required?
faq.answer: Yes. The printout of the online application, with self-attested copies of certificates, must be sent by Speed Post / Registered Post to The Registrar, NIPER Ahmedabad, Palaj, Gandhinagar-382355, Gujarat, and must reach by 28 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What does "Against Lien Vacancy" mean in this notice?
faq.answer: These posts are held on lien by an existing employee. If that employee joins back, the selected candidate will be reverted or their services terminated. If the employee does not return, the selected candidate will be considered for permanent absorption, subject to probation.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post at NIPER Ahmedabad?
faq.answer: Yes, if you meet the eligibility for each post. You must apply for each post separately and pay the application fee separately.
